newsitem.title: USA: Tuboscope Vetco says buys two UK tube cos.
newsitem.headline: Tuboscope Vetco says buys two UK tube cos.

text.p: Tuboscope Vetco International Corp said on Friday it bought two U.K.-based coiled tubing and wireline products companies for a combination of cash, notes and about 130,000 shares of Tuboscope common stock.
SSR (International) Ltd and Pressure Control Engineering Ltd had combined revenues of about $19 million for the 12 months ended July 31, Tuboscope said in a statement.
The companies provide coiled tubing and wireline products to the oilfield services industry, Tuboscope said.

"The acquisition will strengthen Tuboscope's presence in the growing market for coiled tubing and wireline pressure control products, and broaden our depth of product offerings by adding downhole coiled tubing tools and wireline units," Tuboscope President and Chief Executive Officer John Lauletta said in a statement.
Tuboscope also supplies oilfield tubular coating and inspection services, oilfield solids control equipment and services and coiled tubing equipment to the petroleum industry.
SSR manufactures wireline units and pressure control equipment to service oil and gas wells and Pressure Control makes coiled tubing tools and wireline pressure control equipment, Tuboscope said.
Tuboscope was not immediately available to comment on the deal.
